title: Bitcoin loses $60K again: $472M liquidated, record $4.7B ETF exodus | Daily Brief
caption:
bitcoin gave back the whole nvidia rally and slipped under $60k (~$59.7k, -2.4%) 📉 eth -2.1% to ~$1,674, sol -3.9% to ~$69.2. $472m liquidated in 24h, 84% longs. btc etfs -$570m monday (ibit -$509m), november outflows a record $4.71b. fear & greed at 9. next: pce + q3 gdp today, us markets shut thursday for thanksgiving. levels to watch: $64.5k (monday high), $58k (top deribit put). not financial advice.
